links.explanation: Both reports highlight the lack of a legal requirement for quad bike riders to wear crash helmets on public roads. They refer to the same hazard—missing helmet legislation—though the later report adds detail about legally adapted bikes.

sources.title: Motorcycles and ATVs
sources.quote: Motorcycles are less stable and harder for other drivers to see than cars, and they often have high performance capabilities. When motorcycles crash, their riders lack the protection of an enclosed vehicle, so they're more likely to be injured or killed.
